decision: D-012 (option B; supersedes D-011): In the dual-populated and already-marked cases, directive upgrade finishes the vbrief to xbrief move: free destinations are migrated, identical ones skipped, differing ones copied raw to xbrief/archive/ (never overwriting xbrief/), then vbrief/ is deleted. The drift gate is not changed. --keep-legacy on a direct deft migrate:xbrief stays an explicit opt-in; upgrade never passes it. Unit P2-U13, wave 2.1, before P2-U1. No RC: requirements only say upgrade migrates (AC7.8); the changed rule is #2270's.

governingRule.description: polfer decision 2026-11-17 (OVPR fix plan, DECISIONS.md (directive-ovpr-planning-202611) D-012; AC7.8)

whyWinner: polfer's intent: upgraded vbriefs end in xbrief/ and vbrief/ goes away.
